home.eyebrow: VST3 plug-ins for streamers who sing
home.lead: HEARASIDE splits your DAW into what you hear and what your viewers hear: tracks, programs and friends singing with you. Then it sends the viewers’ mix straight to OBS.
home.fine: Windows 10 / 11 · VST3 · works with OBS Studio · no account needed
home.shotAlt: The HEARASIDE Hub: a list of tracks, each with a ‘you hear’ and a ‘viewers hear’ switch and a level slider, and a loudness meter for what viewers hear
home.mix.h2: Click in your ears. Not on stream.
home.mix.text: Every track gets two switches. Keep the click and your talk mic in your headphones only, send the backing track and vocal to viewers, and never ask yourself “can they hear this?” again.
home.mix.try: Try the switches. This only changes the picture.
home.mix.youOn: You hear this (click to turn off)
home.mix.youOff: You don’t hear this (click to turn on)
home.mix.viewersOn: Viewers hear this (click to turn off)
home.mix.viewersOff: Viewers don’t hear this (click to turn on)
home.plugins.h2: Put them where the sound is.
home.plugins.hubText: Builds your headphone mix, sends the viewers’ mix to OBS, watches loudness, and runs the friends room.
home.plugins.track: at the end of each track
home.plugins.trackText: Choose who hears the track. Set levels, pan and delay for viewers. Paste a friend’s link to run their voice through your own plug-ins.
home.plugins.appText: Brings Chrome, Spotify, Discord, the whole computer or a friend into a track, and records it with your DAW.
home.friends.h2: Up to eight voices. One beat.
home.friends.1: Each friend gets a link of their own. They open it in a browser and sing. No install.
home.friends.2: Line up holds your live back just enough that everyone lands on the beat for viewers. Your headphones aren’t delayed.
home.friends.3: Spread them across the stereo field, or put a friend through your own EQ and reverb in the DAW.
home.friends.shotAlt: Share and friends page: three friends, each with a send-in link, a volume and a pan slider, and a switch that lines everyone up for viewers
home.how.1: Run the installer. It adds the VST3 plug-ins and the OBS source.
home.how.2: HEARASIDE Hub on your master. HEARASIDE Track at the end of every track you want to control.
home.how.3: Add a source called HEARASIDE. The Hub connects by itself and shows the delay.
home.how.shotAlt: The HEARASIDE Track plug-in with ‘You hear this track’ and ‘Viewers hear this track’ switches
home.acct.h2: Everything works without one. Signing in keeps your things together.
benefit.links: Links that stay the same, without setting up a website
benefit.friends: Friends see your name and photo when they join
benefit.appearance: Your appearance settings on every computer
home.faq.text: Step-by-step guides in English and Thai, from first install to karaoke with friends.
home.faq.a1: No. Every plug-in works fully without one. An account adds permanent links, your name and photo for friends, and settings that follow you.
home.faq.q2: If my internet drops, do viewers still hear me?
home.faq.a2: Yes. Audio goes from your DAW to OBS on your own computer. Only friends singing over the internet need a connection.
home.faq.q3: How much delay does it add?
home.faq.a3: About one DAW buffer, for example 5.3 ms at 256 samples and 48 kHz. The Hub shows the exact number next to the OBS status.
home.faq.q4: Which DAWs does it work with?
home.faq.a4: Any DAW that loads VST3 on Windows. We test Studio One, Cubase, Reaper, FL Studio and Ableton Live.
dl.winText: One installer, ready to use: HEARASIDE Hub, Track and App Audio (VST3), the HEARASIDE source for OBS, and cloudflared for links over the internet.
dl.macText: Coming later. Create an account and we’ll email you once when it’s ready.
dl.step1: Close your DAW and OBS, then run the installer
dl.step1sub: Windows may ask for administrator permission. If SmartScreen warns about a new app, choose More info › Run anyway.
dl.step2sub: Put HEARASIDE Hub on the master, HEARASIDE Track at the end of each track.
dl.step3: In OBS, add a source called HEARASIDE
dl.step3sub: The Hub connects by itself. The first time, Windows may ask to let your DAW through the firewall.
dl.included: Included: cloudflared, so friends can join over the internet

acct.lead: Changes save automatically. The plug-ins pick them up within a minute.
